findings.description: The Lambda environment contains a plaintext AWS access key ID and secret access key. Environment variables can be exposed through Lambda configuration access, deployment artifacts, logs, or code execution, allowing an attacker to use the embedded credentials outside the function.
The function uses Node.js 12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security updates. Known runtime vulnerabilities may remain exploitable by inputs processed by the function.
